how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) under the ASEAN PhD Fellowship Programme Secretariat on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions are Programme Officer and Executive, with a total of 2 vacancies open for eligible and qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the duly filled application form via email is 09-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they submit before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for Programme Officer?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Programme Officer position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 52,000/- p.m.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Executive?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Executive position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 60,000/- p.m.

faq.question: Q6. What are the qualification requirements for Programme Officer?
faq.answer: Applicants need a Masters degree with excellent performance (CGPA > 9/10 or equivalent) along with short/long term certification in Public Policy and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What are the qualification requirements for Executive?
faq.answer: Applicants need a PhD in IE/OR/Management Research Area from an IIT, or ME/MTech from NIT/IIT with CG > 9, or BE/BTech with CG > 8.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for IIT Delhi Jobs 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need to download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website and email the filled application form along with required documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the short-listing of eligible candidates followed by an online interview conducted by the institute authorities.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for the Programme Officer and Executive positions at IIT Delhi.
